title: GET /api/box/status (200)
description: The Box engine status the dashboard polls. Source: src/box/engine.ts getStatus(). Obtained via a DIRECT call to the REAL BoxEngine.getStatus() on a hermetically-constructed engine (inert deps, no I/O): the /api/box/status registrar does res.json(engine.getStatus()), so the method is the authoritative producer of the wire bytes. TOP LEVEL is CLOSED so an added/removed/renamed headline field is caught. The bounded diagnostic sub-objects (scanner/monitor/charges/reconciliation/metrics/day_pnl/executable_book_diagnostics/risk_bookkeeping) are engine-owned observability rings whose internal field churn is not part of the frontend contract; each is pinned as an OPEN object (presence + object-ness) with a $comment. `config` re-uses the closed box-config contract. `live_manager` is null in paper and an engine-owned live snapshot otherwise, so it is OPEN/null.

order_stream.$comment: Order-update stream status. NOT market-data health: a healthy tick feed is no evidence that fills are observed promptly. See order-stream-status.schema.json.

execution_funnel.$comment: OPEN by design (Task 8): the execution funnel snapshot — outcome counts with explicit denominators, incremented from real execution events. An engine-owned observability ring whose internal field set is not part of the strict frontend contract; pinned as presence + object-ness. Source: ExecutionFunnel.snapshot().

economic_admission.$comment: OPEN by design (Task 8): the last economic-admission decision (five distinct quantities with provenance), or null when no economic control is enabled. Source: CentralBoxExecutionGateway.economicDiagnostics().

market_data_state.$comment: MARKET-DATA transport health, DISTINCT from order-stream health and from the crude market_data_healthy boolean. READY is reachable only after fresh usable depth per traded instrument in the current connection generation; a socket merely being open is not READY. Source: MarketDataStateMachine.state().

market_data_health.$comment: OPEN by design: the MarketDataStateMachine diagnostics (generation, per-instrument readiness, transport-heartbeat / last-frame / last-valid-depth ages, backlog signal). An engine-owned observability object pinned as presence + object-ness. Source: MarketDataStateMachine.diagnostics().

operational_readiness.$comment: SECTION 7. THE ONE authoritative readiness decision. market_data_state and order_stream above are RAW FACTS about two independent transports; this is the single VERDICT derived from them through the SAME permission table the live-entry checkpoint enforces. A client MUST render this rather than recombining the raw facts into a second permission matrix, and MUST NOT show a permitted/ready state when entry.permitted is false. CLOSED, because a silently added or renamed field here would be a silently changed permission.

live_manager.$comment: OPEN by design: null in paper, an engine-owned live-order-manager snapshot otherwise.

excluded_underlyings.$comment: CLOSED. The operator blocklist of underlyings that must never be ENTERED, in any execution mode. Source: src/box/engine.ts listExcludedUnderlyings(). `readable: false` means the durable list could not be read, which REFUSES all new entry (readiness blocker `underlying_exclusions_unreadable`) — a client must render that as the reason nothing is trading, never as an empty blocklist. `persistent: false` means the deployment has no box persistence, so no exclusion could ever have been stored and none is being forgotten.

hub_connected.$comment: The SHARED/FUTURES board lane. With BOX_DEDICATED_MARKET_FEED=true (the default) this is a DIFFERENT socket from the one carrying box option depth, so it is NOT evidence that the box lane is connected. Publishing only this field is why a connected board lane read as a healthy box feed. Use box_lane_connected for the socket the box engine's books actually come from.
hub_connected.description: Shared/futures lane socket connection. Not the box lane.

executable_book_diagnostics.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned book-health counters.

risk_bookkeeping.$comment: OPEN by design: bounded per-attempt risk bookkeeping (observability only).

day_pnl.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned running day-P&L aggregate.

skipped_for_budget.description: Underlyings left unsubscribed because BOX_MAX_SUBSCRIBED_TOKENS ran out. THIS COUNT IS ONLY THE TOKEN BUDGET. Names cut by BOX_MAX_UNDERLYINGS used to be merged in here, which told operators that (for example) 214 names were outside a 2200-token feed budget that in fact had hundreds of tokens to spare, while the setting genuinely responsible went unnamed. Those now live in skipped_for_underlying_cap.

skipped_symbols.description: A bounded sample (at most 25) of the token-budget skips above, for display.

skipped_for_underlying_cap.description: Underlyings left out because BOX_MAX_UNDERLYINGS capped the list — a DIFFERENT limit from skipped_for_budget, with identical symptoms. Reported separately so a client names the setting to change rather than blaming the feed budget. Compare max_underlyings.

skipped_underlying_cap_symbols.description: A bounded sample (at most 25) of the underlying-cap skips, for display.

max_underlyings.description: BOX_MAX_UNDERLYINGS as configured. 0 means no cap. Echoed so the UI can state the value responsible for skipped_for_underlying_cap instead of describing the effect.

scanner.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned scanner counters.

monitor.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned monitor counters.

charges.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned charge-estimator counters.

reconciliation.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned reconciliation counters.

metrics.$comment: OPEN by design: engine-owned rolling latency/slippage/throughput rings.

box_lane_connected.description: The BOX lane's own market-data socket — the one carrying the option depth this engine trades on. Distinct from hub_connected.

box_lane_dedicated.description: True when the box lane is a physically separate socket from the shared board feed (BOX_DEDICATED_MARKET_FEED). When false, hub_connected and box_lane_connected describe the same socket.

universe.$comment: WHY THE SCANNER IS OR IS NOT EVALUATING. `underlyings` is windows.size, which is 0 both when the instrument master came back EMPTY and when the market is merely quiet — those rendered identically, which is how a scanner with a completely empty universe displayed SCANNING for a whole session. `stage` names the FIRST unsatisfied stage of the real pipeline (instruments -> board -> chains -> join -> spots -> windows -> candidates -> subscriptions -> socket -> frames -> depth); every later stage is unreachable, so exactly one blocker is reported. `counts` republishes the figure behind each stage so the verdict can be CHECKED rather than trusted. Source: src/box/universeReadiness.ts assessUniverseReadiness().

readyToEvaluate.description: Whether the engine can evaluate a candidate against real current-generation books. DELIBERATELY NOT the same as `running`: the operator's intent and the engine's capability are different facts, and publishing only the former is the defect this field exists to close.

stage.description: The FIRST unsatisfied stage. `evaluating` is the only value meaning the scanner is genuinely working on real books. `instruments_loading`/`instruments_failed`/`instruments_empty` are three DIFFERENT operator actions (wait / investigate the broker / investigate the filter) and must never be collapsed.

detail.description: Plain language, safe to display verbatim. Names the stage and what to do about it.

transient.description: True when the correct action is to WAIT rather than investigate — the stage clears on its own if the system is healthy.

instruments.description: Rows returned by the last successful instrument-master load. 0 here with instrument_load=loaded is `instruments_empty`: a broker/endpoint problem, not a filter one.

board_rows.description: F&O board rows derived from the dump, BEFORE the chain join.

chains_indexed.description: Option chains indexed from the dump.

board_with_chains.description: Board rows that ALSO have a chain — what the universe loop actually iterates. Nonzero board_rows and chains_indexed with zero here means the two key spaces disagree.

underlyings_missing_spot.description: Joined underlyings with no spot price, so no ATM window can be centred.

depth_observations.description: Usable two-sided book observations this generation. frames_observed > 0 with this at 0 means the socket is alive but delivering nothing executable.

instrument_load.description: Four states on purpose. `loading` and `never_attempted` used to be indistinguishable from `failed`, and they are the two where the correct action is to wait.

instruments_error.description: The broker's own load-failure message, verbatim. Null unless instrument_load is `failed`.

instruments_loaded_at.description: Wall-clock ms of the last SUCCESSFUL load, or null.

instrument_load_failures.description: Consecutive failed attempts. Drives the bounded deduplicated retry.

spot_seed_failed.description: Whether the last REST spot seed threw. A failed seed yields zero windows and therefore zero subscriptions, which is observationally identical to an empty universe — hence it is published rather than only logged.

last_successful_build_at.description: Last universe pass that produced at least one window. Distinguishes `never worked` from `worked until N minutes ago`.

subscriptions_requested.description: A subscribe frame was WRITTEN. NOT a broker acknowledgement — Zerodha's protocol supplies none, so this must never be rendered as confirmed by the broker. Usable depth (counts.depth_observations) is the only real confirmation.
